derivation: amendment A11: `x-default` is compared ASCII case-insensitively, so X-DEFAULT is the x-default value (exactly one), not an invalid tag.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="X-DEFAULT" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-xdefault-uppercase
